caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular composition divided into two distinct sections. The upper portion is made up of small triangles and squares arranged in a grid pattern, with each geometric shape containing a different colored or patterned fill, such as stripes, florals, and solid colors in shades of pink, blue, yellow, brown, tan, and off-white. The lower portion and left border of the rectangle are densely filled with intricate, fine black line drawings of various flowers, plants, and foliage, rendered in detailed monochrome without any color. The stark contrast between the colored geometric patchwork section and the finely detailed botanical illustration section is pronounced. The drawing is situated on a plain, light cream background, and the name "Mary Barnes" is written in the lower right corner.
title: Patchwork Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
